### <a name="sysctl--base"></a>`sysctl::base`

Common part for the sysctl definition. Not meant to be used on its own.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `sysctl::base` class:

* [`purge`](#-sysctl--base--purge)
* [`values`](#-sysctl--base--values)
* [`hiera_merge_values`](#-sysctl--base--hiera_merge_values)
* [`symlink99`](#-sysctl--base--symlink99)
* [`sysctl_dir`](#-sysctl--base--sysctl_dir)
* [`sysctl_dir_path`](#-sysctl--base--sysctl_dir_path)
* [`sysctl_dir_owner`](#-sysctl--base--sysctl_dir_owner)
* [`sysctl_dir_group`](#-sysctl--base--sysctl_dir_group)
* [`sysctl_dir_mode`](#-sysctl--base--sysctl_dir_mode)

##### <a name="-sysctl--base--purge"></a>`purge`

Data type: `Boolean`

Boolean to choose if $sysctl_dir_path should get purged.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-sysctl--base--values"></a>`values`

Data type: `Hash`

Hash of sysctl keys and their values to managed.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-sysctl--base--hiera_merge_values"></a>`hiera_merge_values`

Data type: `Boolean`

Boolean to choose if $values to be used should be searched in hiera.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-sysctl--base--symlink99"></a>`symlink99`

Data type: `Boolean`

Boolean to choose if 99-sysctl.conf should be created.

Default value: `$sysctl::params::symlink99`

##### <a name="-sysctl--base--sysctl_dir"></a>`sysctl_dir`

Data type: `Boolean`

Boolean to choose if $sysctl_dir_path should be managed.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-sysctl--base--sysctl_dir_path"></a>`sysctl_dir_path`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Absolute path of sysctl directory.

Default value: `'/etc/sysctl.d'`

##### <a name="-sysctl--base--sysctl_dir_owner"></a>`sysctl_dir_owner`

Data type: `String[1]`

Owner for sysctl directory.

Default value: `'root'`

##### <a name="-sysctl--base--sysctl_dir_group"></a>`sysctl_dir_group`

Data type: `String[1]`

Group for sysctl directory.

Default value: `'root'`

##### <a name="-sysctl--base--sysctl_dir_mode"></a>`sysctl_dir_mode`

Data type: `Stdlib::Filemode`

Mode for sysctl directory.

Default value: `'0755'`

## Defined types

### <a name="sysctl"></a>`sysctl`

Manage sysctl variable values.

#### Examples

##### 

```puppet
Sample Usage :
sysctl { 'net.ipv6.bindv6only': value => '1' }
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `sysctl` defined type:

* [`ensure`](#-sysctl--ensure)
* [`value`](#-sysctl--value)
* [`prefix`](#-sysctl--prefix)
* [`suffix`](#-sysctl--suffix)
* [`comment`](#-sysctl--comment)
* [`content`](#-sysctl--content)
* [`source`](#-sysctl--source)
* [`enforce`](#-sysctl--enforce)

##### <a name="-sysctl--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

Whether the variable's value should be 'present' or 'absent'.
Defaults to 'present'.

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-sysctl--value"></a>`value`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The value for the sysctl parameter. Mandatory, unless $ensure is 'absent'.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-sysctl--prefix"></a>`prefix`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Optional prefix for the sysctl.d file to be created. Default: none.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-sysctl--suffix"></a>`suffix`

Data type: `String`

Optional suffix for the sysctl.d file to be created. Default: '.conf'.

Default value: `'.conf'`

##### <a name="-sysctl--comment"></a>`comment`

Data type: `Optional[Variant[Array, String[1]]]`

Comment(s) to be added to the sysctl.d file.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-sysctl--content"></a>`content`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Content for the sysctl.d file to be used instead of the template.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-sysctl--source"></a>`source`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::Filesource]`

Source file for the sysctl.d file to be used instead of the template.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-sysctl--enforce"></a>`enforce`

Data type: `Boolean`

Enforce configured value during each run (can't work with custom files).

Default value: `true`
